# Grid

Responsive grid without media queries: as many columns as fit, each at least minChildWidth wide (default 16rem) — four stat cards on desktop, two on a tablet,…

`KenosUI.Grid` · Layout

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Grid />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Grid"></x-import>
```

## Notes

As many columns as fit at ≥ minChildWidth — responsive without media queries.
